about: A command-line tool that fills in text templates with data from files and online sources.

prs.title: Sort works on lists with decimals
prs.broken: Sorting a list of numbers that had both whole numbers and decimals returned it unsorted, which hit any JSON or YAML list with a decimal in it.
prs.changed: Lists of numbers now sort by value, whatever mix they hold.
prs.matters: Templates that sort prices or other numbers give the right order.
